about: Photoshop oracle ledger: every recorded case, classified, with our measured distance (8-bit levels, CIEDE2000). Regenerate the numbers with PAGED_PHOTOSHOP_LEDGER=write; classes and notes are kept.

adjustments/identity.note: Open + save round trip: proves no colour conversion.

adjustments/posterize-4.note: Same bins (floor(c*n)/(n-1)); values sitting EXACTLY on a bin edge (k/4 in the stimulus) fall the other way in Photoshop - a tie rule, a whole level on those samples only.

adjustments/threshold-128.note: Threshold 128 maps to 128/255 on the engine's luma cut.

adjustments/levels.note: Same formula (input range, gamma, output range); Photoshop runs it through its own table, up to 2.7 levels apart.

adjustments/curves.note: Same control points; Photoshop's curve spline differs slightly from image_core::curve_lut (up to 4.2 levels mid-tone).

adjustments/exposure+1.note: Exposure is a gain on light decoded with a 2.2 power (Photoshop's); within 2 levels.

adjustments/brightness-contrast-legacy.note: Engine: c' = (c - 0.5) x contrast + 0.5 + brightness, mapped as brightness 30 -> 30/255, contrast 40 -> 1.4. Photoshop's legacy formula is not that line.

adjustments/brightness-contrast.note: Photoshop's non-legacy Brightness/Contrast is a tone curve, not the engine's linear stretch (same mapping as the legacy case).

adjustments/hue-saturation.note: Engine: luma-preserving hue ROTATION (adjust.hue_rotate) + luma-mix saturation; Photoshop shifts hue in HSL. Different models, large on saturated colours.

adjustments/hue-only.note: Hue rotation model vs Photoshop's HSL hue shift (see hue-saturation).

adjustments/vibrance.note: Engine vibrance = saturation weighted by (1 - existing saturation); Photoshop's vibrance also protects skin tones. Mapped 50 -> 0.5.

adjustments/color-balance.note: Engine: tonal-range-weighted opponent offsets (+-100 -> +-1) with luminosity restore; Photoshop's tonal weighting and scale differ.

adjustments/channel-mixer.note: Percent rows map to fractions; linear, exact up to f16.

adjustments/photo-filter.note: Engine: mix(c, c x filter, density) + luminosity restore; Photoshop's gel model differs.

adjustments/black-white.note: Default six weights; the engine's hue-sector mix reproduces Photoshop.

filters/gaussian-r2.note: The adjust chain's blur stage is broken (pinned in adjust_defects.rs: a constant image does not survive blur_sigma; transparent past the first tile). Radius 2 -> sigma 2.

filters/gaussian-r5.note: Same broken chain blur as gaussian-r2 (radius 5 -> sigma 5).

filters/unsharp-100-r1.5.note: Unsharp rides the same broken chain blur (fixed sigma 1.5 = Photoshop radius 1.5, amount 100 % -> 1.0).

filters/motion-30-r10.note: conv.motion box-averages along the angle; Photoshop's motion kernel and end weighting differ (mean 3 levels, edges larger).

filters/emboss.note: conv.emboss (angle 135, height 3) is the engine's own relief formula; Photoshop's amount/height scale differs.

filters/find-edges.note: Interior agrees (mean 0.5 level); the border row/column differs - Photoshop and the edge-clamped window treat the image edge differently.

filters/mosaic-8.note: geom.mosaic cells are averaged differently from Photoshop's (cell value and grid origin); mean 3.7 levels.

filters/median-r1.note: Photoshop median radius 1 = the engine's 3x3 rank.median3.

filters/offset-20-10-wrap.note: geom.offset with the wrap edge policy.
